versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-aes-sysom-pai-diagnosis 0.0.1 — Initial release

- Enables deep SysOM diagnosis for Alibaba Cloud PAI EAS and DLC products, identifying root causes of common instance-level issues.
- Enforces strong credential security by preventing display or input of sensitive keys and requiring configuration outside the session.
- Implements strict parameter confirmation, including auto-inference and validation for `region`, `instance`, `product`, and time ranges.
- Provides a two-phase workflow: environment setup (CLI version check, plugin update, credential verification) and guided diagnosis execution.
- Includes built-in handling for RAM permission errors and special support for EAS service ID and DLC (Lingjun) job validation.
- Requires all business CLI operations to use a custom User-Agent string for tracking.
